text.en: Someone who reports sexual harassment at work deserves to be heard with respect.
text.hinglish: Jo vyakti kaam par yaun utpeedan ki report karta hai, use samman ke saath suna jaana chahiye.

text.en: A woman who dresses in a striking way at work is partly responsible for unwanted attention.
text.hinglish: Jo mahila kaam par bhadkile tareeke se kapde pehanti hai, anchahe dhyan ke liye woh aanshik roop se zimmedar hai.

text.en: Being friendly with a colleague does not invite that colleague's unwanted advances.
text.hinglish: Kisi sahkarmi ke saath dostana hona uske anchahe prastavon ko nyota dena nahi hai.

text.en: A man who is friendly with female colleagues should expect them to misread it.
text.hinglish: Jo purush mahila sahkarmiyon ke saath dostana hai, use maan lena chahiye ki woh ise galat samjhengi.

text.en: What a person wore to work is no excuse for harassing them.
text.hinglish: Kaam par kisi ne kya pehna tha, yeh use pareshan karne ka bahana nahi ho sakta.

text.en: A woman who reports harassment should be encouraged to handle it quietly rather than make a fuss.
text.hinglish: Jo mahila utpeedan ki report kare, use hungama karne ki jagah chupchap nipatane ke liye protsahit karna chahiye.

text.en: A man who dresses in a striking way at work is partly responsible for unwanted attention.
text.hinglish: Jo purush kaam par bhadkile tareeke se kapde pehanta hai, anchahe dhyan ke liye woh aanshik roop se zimmedar hai.

text.en: Employers should protect a person who reports harassment from any punishment for speaking up.
text.hinglish: Employers ko utpeedan ki report karne wale vyakti ko bolne ke liye kisi bhi saza se bachana chahiye.

text.en: A woman who is friendly with male colleagues should expect them to misread it.
text.hinglish: Jo mahila purush sahkarmiyon ke saath dostana hai, use maan lena chahiye ki woh ise galat samjhenge.

text.en: Taking a harassment matter to the proper committee is a reasonable step, not a way of making trouble.
text.hinglish: Utpeedan ka mamla sahi samiti ke paas le jaana ek uchit kadam hai, pareshani khadi karne ka tareeka nahi.

text.en: A man who reports harassment should be encouraged to handle it quietly rather than make a fuss.
text.hinglish: Jo purush utpeedan ki report kare, use hungama karne ki jagah chupchap nipatane ke liye protsahit karna chahiye.

text.en: If a person stays silent for a while, it does not mean the harassment did not happen.
text.hinglish: Agar koi vyakti kuch samay chup rehta hai, to iska matlab yeh nahi ki utpeedan hua hi nahi.
